four-week-cash.title: Cash available on each payment date
four-week-cash.note: 2–29 November 2026. Each step is a listed payment in or out. Below $0 means a shortfall.
four-week-cash.accessibleDescription: Two forecasts start with $30,000 and end with $35,000. If the $40,000 customer payment arrives on 16 November, the balance stays at or above $15,000. If it arrives on 26 November, the forecast falls to minus $10,000 on 20 November. Below zero is a funding gap, not an agreed overdraft.
